distribution.name: incident_event_log.csv
distribution.description: This is an event log of an incident management process extracted from data gathered from the audit system of an instance of the ServiceNowTM platform used by an IT company. The event log is enriched with data loaded from a relational database underlying a corresponding process-aware information system. Information was anonymized for privacy.

field.name: number
field.description: incident identifier.

field.name: incident_state
field.description: eight levels controlling the incident management process transitions from opening until closing the case.

field.name: active
field.description: boolean attribute that shows whether the record is active or closed/canceled.

field.name: reassignment_count
field.description: number of times the incident has the group or the support analysts changed.

field.name: reopen_count
field.description: number of times the incident resolution was rejected by the caller.

field.name: sys_mod_count
field.description: number of incident updates until that moment.

field.name: made_sla
field.description: boolean attribute that shows whether the incident exceeded the target SLA.

field.name: caller_id
field.description: identifier of the user affected.

field.name: opened_by
field.description: identifier of the user who reported the incident.

field.name: opened_at
field.description: incident user opening date and time

field.name: sys_created_by
field.description: identifier of the user who registered the incident.

field.name: sys_created_at
field.description: incident system creation date and time.

field.name: sys_updated_by
field.description: identifier of the user who updated the incident and generated the current log record.

field.name: sys_updated_at
field.description: incident system update date and time.

field.name: contact_type
field.description: categorical attribute that shows by what means the incident was reported.

field.name: location
field.description: identifier of the location of the place affected.

field.name: category
field.description: first-level description of the affected service.

field.name: subcategory
field.description: second-level description of the affected service (related to the first level description, i.e., to category).

field.name: u_symptom
field.description: description of the user perception about service availability.

field.name: cmdb_ci
field.description: (confirmation item) identifier used to report the affected item (not mandatory).

field.name: impact
field.description: description of the impact caused by the incident.

field.name: urgency
field.description: description of the urgency informed by the user for the incident resolution.

field.name: priority
field.description: calculated by the system based on 'impact' and 'urgency'.

field.name: assignment_group
field.description: identifier of the support group in charge of the incident.

field.name: assigned_to
field.description: identifier of the user in charge of the incident.

field.name: knowledge
field.description: boolean attribute that shows whether a knowledge base document was used to resolve the incident.

field.name: u_priority_confirmation
field.description: boolean attribute that shows whether the priority field has been double-checked.

field.name: notify
field.description: categorical attribute that shows whether notifications were generated for the incident.

field.name: problem_id
field.description: identifier of the problem associated with the incident.

field.name: rfc
field.description: (request for change) identifier of the change request associated with the incident.

field.name: vendor
field.description: identifier of the vendor in charge of the incident.

field.name: caused_by
field.description: identifier of the RFC responsible by the incident.

field.name: closed_code
field.description: identifier of the resolution of the incident.

field.name: resolved_by
field.description: identifier of the user who resolved the incident.

field.name: resolved_at
field.description: incident user resolution date and time (dependent variable).

field.name: closed_at
field.description: incident user close date and time (dependent variable).

name: Incident Response Log
description:
### Context

This is an event log of an incident management process extracted from data gathered from the audit system of an instance of the ServiceNowTM platform used by an IT company. 

### Content

The event log is enriched with data loaded from a relational database underlying a corresponding process-aware information system. Information was anonymized for privacy.

Number of instances: 141,712 events (24,918 incidents)
Number of attributes: 36 attributes (1 case identifier, 1 state identifier, 32 descriptive attributes, 2 dependent variables)

The attributed closed_at is used to determine the dependent variable for the time completion prediction task. The attribute resolved_at is highly correlated with closed_a. In this event log, some rows may have the same values (they are equal) since not all attributes involved in the real-world process are present in the log.

Attributes used to record textual information are not placed in this log. The missing values should be considered unknown information.

### Inspiration

Create a Machine learning application which predicts the estimated time and date for the final closure of a opened ticket based on the given attributes.
